summary: Iteration 199: Tested Morning Briefing enriched fields and Sleep Alarm API. All 14 backend tests PASSED. Morning briefing now returns exercises (list with title/sets/reps/done), exercises_done, exercises_total, nutrition (daily_calories, meal_count, meal_names, has_plan), reminders (type/time/title), and sleep (from sleep-alarm API with adjustments). context_for_next_testing_agent: Morning briefing API (/api/nora/morning-briefing) now includes: exercises (list with title/sets/reps/done), exercises_done (int), exercises_total (int), nutrition (daily_calories, meal_count, meal_names, has_plan), reminders (list with type/time/title), sleep (from sleep-alarm with wake_time, bedtime, sleep_need_hours, adjustments).
